But rule 19: social hostility and state impunity do reach visitors who are outed. Also general crime/kidnapping advisory — out of scope unless it raises trans-specific risk.

Considering all: no documented universal exposure for visitors (no border issues, no facility bans documented, marriage equality, legal recognition available). I'd say 0.45-0.50. The country has strong formal rights, visible acceptance infrastructure (Pride, gay hub, legal marriage, constitutional protections), but enforcement gap and real violence. The violence is mostly local-sphere but police abuse reaches visitors.

Considering severity ladder: police extortion (3), violence/murder with impunity (5 but frequency uncertain, mostly local), service friction, social hostility. Probability of outing moderate. I'd give 0.48.
